us.sec_fee_note: SEC Section 31, sells only, $27.80 per $1M (FY2025 rate)

fx.gst_slabs: 1% up to Rs 1L (min Rs 250); Rs 1,000 + 0.5% to Rs 10L; Rs 5,500 + 0.1% above, capped Rs 60,000

india.ltcg_note: Foreign ETFs are unlisted securities for Indian tax: 24-month threshold, 12.5% without indexation
india.stcg_note: Short-term gains on foreign assets are taxed at slab, not at the 15%/20% rates that apply to Indian equity

surcharge_bands.label: above Rs 1Cr (capital gains surcharge is capped here)

india.tcs_note: Charged on money sent OUT under LRS above Rs 10L per FY, and creditable against the year's tax -- a cash-flow cost
india.rule_115: Capital gains on foreign assets are computed in rupees: cost at the rate on the buy date, proceeds at the rate on the sell date, so rupee depreciation is taxable gain

GLD.note: grantor trust; no US tax for a non-resident alien on gains

FXE.note: CurrencyShares grantor trust; thinner catalogues may omit it

FXY.note: CurrencyShares grantor trust; thinner catalogues may omit it

DBC.note: commodity pool, issues a K-1 -- often unavailable on Indian LRS platforms

USO.note: commodity pool, issues a K-1 -- often unavailable on Indian LRS platforms

UUP.note: commodity pool, issues a K-1 -- often unavailable on Indian LRS platforms

BTC-USD.note: LRS cannot be remitted to buy crypto; INR rail only, 30% + 1% TDS

ETH-USD.note: LRS cannot be remitted to buy crypto; INR rail only, 30% + 1% TDS

access_label.limited: K-1 commodity pool -- check your platform
access_label.separate: Not via LRS -- Indian exchange, different tax

price_basis: Both the backtest and the live feed use ADJUSTED closes, so ETF expense ratios and reinvested dividends are already inside the return series. Nothing extra needs deducting for either.

book_cost_model.note: What the simulation itself charges, per side, per unit of turnover. Left untouched on purpose: it is the number the validated backtest used.

dividend_note: The paper book models price returns only. A real holder would receive ETF distributions, lose 25% to US withholding, and pay Indian slab tax with a foreign tax credit. Neither the income nor the tax is in these figures.
disclaimer: Estimate from published rates. It cannot know other income, carried-forward losses, or residency position. Not tax advice.
